recommendation.engine_name: Google Document AI Enterprise Document OCR

units.page: One submitted image/PDF page for page-billed services.
units.line: One separately submitted line image, not an amortised share of a multi-line page.
units.money: List-price snapshot; discounts/free tiers/tax excluded unless stated; EUR not converted to USD.
units.unknown: null or explicit unknown means not established, never zero or unsupported unless explicitly marked.
units.dates: Every sourced cell is checked as of 2026-10-08. Source publication/update dates are separate; null means unknown.

baseline.value: Recorded E2 result: CLLG 1.30% strict NFD CER and 0.992 pooled mark F1 on 300 real polytonic gold lines from Gazette/Appian; Parliament was excluded as Vouli-shared. This research did not rerun it.
Tesseract 4 grc at 33% CER is the research brief's stated baseline, not a new measurement.

Existing google/azure/mistral entries are gated service stubs requiring both environment configuration and an explicit factory. Their current read method returns NFD text only; confidence persistence is additional integration work.

The 44-entry parliament fixture index contains layer and CLLG readings; owner_notes is empty and no separate human gold transcript field is present. Treat the user's owner-checked status as needing its authoritative transcript bound to these IDs.
The current E2 bake-off is a 300-real + 300-synthetic procedure with selection/overlap gates. It is not already a 444-line, three-cohort hosted test command.

Reading or Guessing? (2026-05-26) examines open-weight VLMs on 90 pages from 30 Ancient Greek editions and documents visually ungrounded transcription. It does not supply GPT/Gemini/Claude-specific CER.

test_plan.duration: one engineering day after authorised account access; onboarding delay excluded

cohorts.requirement: Reuse exact existing real-gold IDs, source document IDs, crop and transcript hashes and exclusions; no reselection after viewing outputs.
Obtain authoritative owner-checked transcripts mapped to fixture IDs before scoring. Existing layer/CLLG strings are not gold. If unavailable, retain predictions but report this cohort unscored.

Freeze 100 manually checked born-digital Greek lines, rasterized at a fixed resolution; include mixed Greek/Latin and available Cyrillic. Corpus not staged by this research; no input PDF text layer sent to readers.

schedule.task: Freeze 444-line manifest/rights/provenance/GT and original-resolution crops. Bind available owner corrections; predeclare script/mark/curl strata. If GT unavailable, label shortfall.

Implement and smoke-test recommended DocAI factory on an authorised worker, preserving raw JSON/confidence and unit usage. Verify 10 non-test lines and one missing/failed request path. Existing harness requires a separate cohort driver or scoped extension.

Run two complete 444-line passes with fixed version/options, shuffled order and no client result-cache reuse. Reuse exact-image/version CLLG predictions if receipt-bound; otherwise rerun CLLG on permitted compute. Add ready Azure/Mistral/Vision adapters only within remaining time.
Score all cohorts separately and pooled as secondary; inspect disagreements blind to engine labels, confidence/error coupling, failure counts and repeat-call differences.
Produce evidence-bound comparison, request/usage cost ledger and a keep/qualify/reject decision. No production replacement based only on a language listing or 44-line aggregate.

metrics.strict_nfd_cer: sum Levenshtein(NFD(prediction),NFD(gold)) / sum len(NFD(gold)); preserve case, spaces, punctuation, combining marks and final sigma; no NFKC, transliteration, accent stripping, trimming or whitespace collapse.
metrics.mark_f1: Use existing frozen base/mark alignment and categories: pooled micro 2TP/(2TP+FP+FN), plus acute/grave/circumflex, breathing, diaeresis and iota-subscript breakdown. Marks on wrong base positions cannot count as correct. Null if denominator zero.
metrics.greek_to_latin: Aligned Greek-GT to Latin-prediction substitutions using frozen explicit homoglyph map; report count and per 1,000 Greek base letters. Genuine Latin GT is not an error. Report Cyrillic confusions separately.
metrics.determinism: Two independently submitted requests with identical bytes/version/options; raw-text exact match and NFD-text exact match, changed-line rate and inter-call CER; preserve request IDs/timestamps.
metrics.confidence: Retain native level, scale, raw spans and boxes; score word/symbol error-versus-confidence and disagreement recall at human-review budgets. Do not invent char confidence from word scores or turn one NFC-symbol confidence into independent NFD-mark probabilities.
metrics.complementarity: CLLG-wrong/new-correct and CLLG-correct/new-wrong counts, joint-wrong agreement, marks and script errors; coverage and disagreement precision/recall matter more than agreement alone.
metrics.operational: Complete-request p50/p95, total wall time, queue/poll overhead, billed pages/image/input/output/reasoning tokens, retries, currency and minimum subscription spend. Remote wall time is not local CPU ms/line.
metrics.failures: Publish successful-output scores plus failure-aware scores (missing prediction treated as empty), missing count and total denominator. Never omit failed lines silently.
metrics.uncertainty: Paired bootstrap by source document when enough documents exist; mark small document/44-line intervals as weak. Do not tune prompts/confidence thresholds on these evaluation labels then report the same score as held out.

settings.input: Identical original-resolution PNG crops with fixed padding preserving accents. Record any scale/deskew in receipts. Cloud-minimum-size padding must be disclosed; no automatic corrective rewriting.
settings.prompt: Transcribe only the visible text exactly, preserving Greek diacritics, case, punctuation, spacing, and script. Do not modernize, translate, complete, or correct the text. Return only the transcription.
settings.llm_controls: No gold, CLLG suggestion, document title or retrieval context in the prompt. Fix supported decoding/effort settings. Sonnet 5.5 must not receive temperature=0.
settings.page_context: Optional separate 10–20-page exploratory arm to test curl/layout/reading order; derive gold-aligned lines by coordinates. Keep its cost/scores separate from 444 isolated crops.
settings.rates: Start serial or bounded two in-flight requests, obey provider limits and Retry-After; no stress test. For Transkribus, resolve infrastructure-benchmark restriction first.

cost.notes: Proposed spending cap, not a spend authorisation or invoice. Add retries, taxes and billed warmups. Mistral image unit assumption must be confirmed. Free credits may reduce charges; budget as if already consumed. Transkribus subscriptions excluded.

test_plan.decision: Keep CLLG as incumbent. Qualify an added verification reader only after complete coverage, acceptable marks/script errors, repeatability and demonstrated complementary corrections. Any replacement or automatic acceptance threshold needs a separate held-out decision; current operational rank is not an accuracy rank.

steps.action: On an authorised account/worker, select a billing-enabled Google Cloud project; enable documentai.googleapis.com. No gcloud/auth/billing checks were executed during research.

Console: Document AI > Processor Gallery > Enterprise Document OCR > Create processor; choose EU. Record project ID and processor ID; choose stable pretrained-ocr-v2.1-2024-08-07 and verify it is available in eu.

Grant the caller roles/documentai.apiUser for the target resource/project. For user ADC, also grant Service Usage Consumer (serviceusage.services.use) on the quota project. The setup administrator separately handles API enablement. Keep credentials outside the repository.

Use an approved existing service identity or user ADC. For user ADC, run gcloud auth application-default login, then gcloud auth application-default set-quota-project PROJECT_ID. Point GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS at the actual ADC JSON path because this harness explicitly checks that variable.

Set GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT, DOCUMENTAI_PROCESSOR_ID, DOCUMENTAI_LOCATION=eu and GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS. The proposed adapter must separately consume DOCUMENTAI_PROCESSOR_VERSION=pretrained-ocr-v2.1-2024-08-07 (not currently an enforced harness variable).

Implement a separate, reviewed module:factory hook accepting service name and returning callable(Path)->str; capture raw response/confidence alongside text. Configure kind=service, service=google, factory=<actual module>:<actual factory>, and explicitly enable --service for the appropriate driver. Credentials alone are insufficient.

Send PNG bytes through the version-specific EU process endpoint with enableSymbol=true and enableNativePdfParsing=false, no language hints initially and no premium OCR add-ons. Validate text, token/symbol confidence, request IDs, region and billing unit on non-test images before the two evaluation passes.

enable_first_setup.acceptance: An actual successful response with usable word/symbol confidence plus a receipt-bound adapter and explicit service enablement is the enablement milestone. This research did not reach or claim that milestone.
enable_first_setup.quota_header: For direct REST using user ADC, send x-goog-user-project: PROJECT_ID; auth libraries may supply it from ADC. Source G13, checked 2026-10-08.
